operations.description: Place 1.54 g ammonium citrate (reported as 8 mmol) in a 50 mL beaker. Add 15 mL deionized water, 87 µL (1 mmol) MPA and 0.25 g (0.84 mmol) InCl3·4H2O, then stir until completely dissolved. Adjust pH to 7 with 1 M NaOH. Add AgNO3 solution containing 0.03 g (0.16 mmol), followed by 0.38 g (1.60 mmol) Na2S·9H2O. The source reports a deep-brown solution upon full dissolution. Transfer to a cleaned 100 mL three-neck flask.

quality.review_scope: Main PDF pp.1–7 are the extracted scientific scope. The independent full auditor and third-agent corrective auditor accepted the source claims in r10. SI pp.1–7 were inspected as corroborating context; no additional SI-derived numerical extraction is admitted. Presentation and delivery remain pending.
missing_fields: Exact final stock volume, Zn/S stock speciation and concentration; shell thicknesses for ZnS-1 through ZnS-5; exact coating-step count and batch equivalence of Figure 1d-f to §2.4; measured product atom coordinates; SI Figure S4 was inspected as corroborating context; no new SI-derived numeric extraction is admitted.
Exact core batch for optimized 35.62% PLQY; unambiguous total additions under §2.4 repetition wording.
conflicts: Method §2.4 (main p.2) says 96 °C for 45 min for AIS core; Scheme 1 (main p.3) draws 15 min and purification before shell; neither is silently substituted.
Method §2.4 reports ammonium citrate as both 1.54 g and 8 mmol; these values are retained exactly as printed and have not been reconciled to a formula-derived molar mass.
Introduction (main p.2) calls the ligand thioglycolic acid; Materials and §2.4 (main p.2) specify 3-mercaptopropionic acid (MPA).
§2.4 main p.2 gives 96 °C and 15 min for a ZnS-stock addition/hold; §3.1 main p.4 says shell growth at 100 °C; Figure 1c inset displays 96 °C.

Displayed three-step coating follows Scheme 1 (main p.3) and the three-step description in §3.1 (main p.5). The §2.4 wording (main p.2) describes an initial addition/hold followed by repeating the process three times, leaving total additions ambiguous. No definite fourth-step recipe, cumulative aliquot dose or total hold time is inferred. Figure 1c (main p.3) separately plots ZnS-1 through ZnS-5; their complete variant recipes are not specified.
Scheme 1 main p.3 depicts purification between core and shell stages, whereas §2.4 main p.2 places ethanol/centrifugation after the shell steps.
§3.1 main p.5 assigns orthorhombic AgInS2 while also allowing cubic AgIn5S8; external cubic ZnS cell is only a shell component reference, not an AIS core or interface coordinate label.
